I estimated this from the photo alone, so every figure is approximate. The meal appears to contain these items:

- Two wrap halves, about 1 wrap, with chicken or cheese and lettuce: ~350 kcal
- Soup, about 200 ml of corn chowder: ~120 kcal
- Side salad: ~40 kcal
- Brownie: ~230 kcal
- Fruit cup: ~80 kcal
- Orange juice, about 150 ml: ~65 kcal
- Dark drink, possibly cola or prune juice: ~60 kcal

Together these come to about 945 kcal served.

I assumed some food would be left over, about 15% of the total, or roughly 140 kcal. That leaves about 805 kcal eaten.

For the eaten portion I estimated the macronutrients as follows:

- Protein: ~25 g
- Carbohydrate: ~115 g
- Fat: ~32 g
